messages.subject: Error on deploying apps
parts:

messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Error on deploying apps

Adam,

Sorry for the trouble you were having. One of servers was wedged, which was causing this error (and also causing apps not to load). I've corrected the problem and deploys/reloads should be working.

-Andy
